[b]Extradition[/b]

After reviewing Blarfghanistans extradition request, the Great Parliamentary Assembly voted in favour of the request. Almost immediately, the police began the search for Welphred Jost. He was tracked down to a small town in the state of Solphoris.He put up a small fight but the police managed to take him into custody. Hydronian law states that he may be freely extradited, without trial on Hydronias part. This is because he has neither a citizenship nor asylum request. Both of these would most likely have drawn the attention of the government, but it appears that his decision has turned against him. The police are releasing him to Blarfghanistan in 2 days. An unmarked white plane will arrive at Blarfghanistan, carrying Jost and he will then be handed over to Blarfghanistan special forces. Hydronia recognises the need for justice, but will only agree to hand over Jost if he is given a fair trial. If Blarfghanistan is unable to provide that, then Hydronia will try him in our court of law.
